description: Na₂Zr₂Si₂SO₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Zr sites. In the first Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.30 Å. In the second Zr site, Zr is bonded to six O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zr-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 17-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.66 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four ZrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-35°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.46-1.50 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Zr and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Zr and one S atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one S atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Zr, and one S atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zr, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Zr, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ZrSi trigonal pyramids.
